sf.label: Stockfish 19
sf.method: Baseline: unrestricted MultiPV 3 at every position, 10M nodes, last completed iteration. Candidate comparisons (60M nodes) and deep checks (200M nodes) restrict the root moves and keep their own budgets.

notes.text: 37...Nf8 permits 38.Rd8+ and 39.Rxc8; in the played line White pushes the passed c-pawn and keeps a strong initiative. 37...h5 provides a more resilient defense in the local engine search. The depth-15 Lite score difference is small, growing at depths 21 and 24. A separate historical CDB result is unverified at current depth and date.
Stockfish 19, 16 Nov 2026 (1 thread, 200M nodes, depth 40, deep check): h5 −5.10, played Nf8 −7.75 (mover POV). The catalog alternative is better by 2.65 pawns.
